{{Quote|Boom goes the detonite!|Languss Tuno|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]''</ref>}}
'''Detonite''' was the standard explosive substance in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Description==
[[File:Detonite.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The result of a detonite bomb]]
Detonite was a putty-like explosive which, by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], had been developed into a fairly stable substance that would typically detonate only when charged with electricity, extreme radiation, or tremendous kinetic energy. After exceeding its shelf life of ten years, however, it could destabilize and subsequently explode much more easily. Detonite was commonly formed into small fist-sized cubes for sale and use, while very tiny detonite charges, sometimes known as "micronite," were also used in pyrotechnics and more precise engineering applications. Detonite could also be made into a gel used in the creation of demolition materials like detonite tape.<ref name="RoE" />

==History==
{{Quote|Imperials don't appreciate subtlety. Use more detonite.|A Rebel SpecForce platoon sergeant|<ref name="RoE" />}}
During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], detonite was the standard [[Explosive charge/Legends|explosive charge]] used in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="RPG" /> It was used for all sorts of high explosive applications, from military demolitions to civil engineering jobs. At that time, a fist-sized cube of the material cost 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="RoE" />

Detonite was used in [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]], particularly the [[C-22 fragmentation grenade]]<ref name="The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> and [[MM-40 thermal charge]].<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 23">[[Knights of the Old Republic 23|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 23]]</ref> It also was formed into [[Shaped charge/Legends|shaped charges]], such as the [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions]] [[Pre-shaped Detonite Charge]]; Merr-Sonn also infused plastic adhesive tape with detonite gel to create [[Flex-5 Detonite Tape]].<ref name="RoE" />
